sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN budget >= 3962000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 2011000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket,
        location,
        MIN(budget) AS min_budget,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Legal' THEN 1 END) AS legal_count
    FROM departments
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3962000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 2011000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, location
) AS agg
WHERE min_budget > 3011000
ORDER BY legal_count DESC, location
code:

    df_departments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3962000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 2011000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
        "location",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("budget").alias("min_budget"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Legal", 1)).alias("legal_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_budget") > 3011000)
    .orderBy(F.col("legal_count").desc(), "location")
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(duration_sec * 100, 2) AS duration_sec_adjusted
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec IS NOT NULL OR event_type = 'purchase'
),
summary AS (
    SELECT session_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_home, MAX(event_time) AS latest_event_time
    FROM base
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
WHERE pct_home > 58
ORDER BY session_id DESC
LIMIT 3
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec").isNotNull() | (F.col("event_type") == "purchase"))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_adjusted", F.round((F.col("duration_sec") * 100), 2))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_home"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("latest_event_time"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("pct_home") > 58)
    .orderBy(F.col("session_id").desc())
    .limit(3)
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.rating >= 3.7 THEN 'high' WHEN s.rating >= 1.8 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) AS unique_stores, MIN(i.last_restock) AS min_last_restock FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id WHERE i.store_id IN (1, 3) GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.rating >= 3.7 THEN 'high' WHEN s.rating >= 1.8 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END ORDER BY rating_bucket DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("p.supplier_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("i.store_id").isin([1, 3]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("s.rating") >= 3.7, "high").when(F.col("s.rating") >= 1.8, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("unique_stores"),
        F.min(F.col("i.last_restock")).alias("min_last_restock"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_bucket").desc())
)

WITH filtered_order_items AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE (quantity <> 6 AND order_id IN (12, 23, 26)) OR unit_price < 290
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 330 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
        order_id,
        MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range,
        MAX(unit_price) AS max_unit_price
    FROM filtered_order_items
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 330 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, order_id
)
SELECT
    unit_price_bucket,
    order_id,
    quantity_range,
    max_unit_price
FROM agg
WHERE max_unit_price > 320;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_order_items = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(((F.col("quantity") != 6) & F.col("order_id").isin([12, 23, 26])) | (F.col("unit_price") < 290))
    .withColumn("quantity_filled", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)))
)

agg = (
    filtered_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 330, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 130, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
        F.max("unit_price").alias("max_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("max_unit_price") > 320)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "order_id", "quantity_range", "max_unit_price")
)

sql:
SELECT MONTH(orders.order_date) AS order_month, orders.channel, SUM(order_items.unit_price * order_items.quantity) AS revenue
FROM order_items
RIGHT JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
WHERE order_items.quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY MONTH(orders.order_date), orders.channel
ORDER BY order_month DESC, channel ASC
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items.alias("order_items")
    .join(df_orders.alias("orders"), F.col("orders.id") == F.col("order_items.order_id"), "right")
    .join(df_customers.alias("customers"), F.col("customers.id") == F.col("orders.customer_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("order_items.quantity").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(
        F.month(F.col("orders.order_date")).alias("order_month"),
        F.col("orders.channel"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum((F.col("order_items.unit_price") * F.col("order_items.quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_month").desc(), "channel")
    .limit(10)
)

    SELECT city, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'SMB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_smb, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city))) AS city_values
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY city
) AS s
WHERE pct_smb >= 59;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_customers
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("segment") == "SMB", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_smb"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city"))).alias("city_values"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("pct_smb") >= 59)
    .select("city", "pct_smb", "city_values")
)

WITH filtered_accounts AS (
    SELECT *, TRIM(account_type) AS clean_account_type
    FROM accounts
    WHERE account_type = 'SAVINGS' AND status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'FROZEN')
),
accounts_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS opened_month,
        status,
        COUNT(DISTINCT balance) AS unique_customers,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_open
    FROM filtered_accounts
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date), status
)
SELECT
    opened_month,
    status,
    unique_customers,
    pct_open
FROM accounts_stats

)

    filtered_accounts
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("opened_month"), "status")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("balance").alias("unique_customers"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_open"),

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN ss.revenue >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN ss.revenue >= 900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS revenue_bucket,
    ss.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) AS unique_products,
    MAX(i.last_restock) AS latest_last_restock
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IN (1, 6, 8, 9)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN ss.revenue >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN ss.revenue >= 900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, ss.product_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) > 1
ORDER BY product_id DESC, revenue_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ss"), (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("ss.store_id")) & (F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("ss.product_id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("i.product_id").isin([1, 6, 8, 9]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("ss.revenue") >= 4000, "high").when(F.col("ss.revenue") >= 900, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("revenue_bucket"),
        F.col("ss.product_id"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("unique_products"),
        F.max(F.col("i.last_restock")).alias("latest_last_restock"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("unique_products") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc(), "revenue_bucket")
)

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS paid_month,
    method,
    ROUND(STDDEV(amount), 2) AS stddev_amount,
    ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_cash,
    MIN(amount) AS min_amount
FROM payments
WHERE order_id IN (12, 18, 21, 40)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM'), method
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) >= 78
ORDER BY paid_month DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([12, 18, 21, 40]))
    .groupBy(F.date_format("paid_at", "yyyy-MM").alias("paid_month"), "method")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("amount"), 2).alias("stddev_amount"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("method") == "cash", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_cash"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("failed_amount"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("failed_amount") >= 78)
    .drop("failed_amount")
    .orderBy(F.col("paid_month").desc())
)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.credit_limit >= 14300 THEN 'high' WHEN c.credit_limit >= 6900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS credit_limit_bucket, DATE_FORMAT(c.signup_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS signup_month, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(we.event_type)) AS event_type_list, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(we.page))) AS page_values FROM web_events we INNER JOIN sessions s ON we.session_id = s.id RIGHT OUTER JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.credit_limit >= 14300 THEN 'high' WHEN c.credit_limit >= 6900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, DATE_FORMAT(c.signup_date, 'yyyy-MM');
code:

    df_web_events.alias("we")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("we.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "right")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("c.credit_limit") >= 14300, "high").when(F.col("c.credit_limit") >= 6900, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("credit_limit_bucket"),

    )

sql:
with filtered_accounts as (
    select *, datediff(current_date(), opened_date) as days_since_opened_date
    from accounts
    where account_type = 'CREDIT' and opened_date < '2025-06-16'
),
agg as (
    select date_trunc('MONTH', opened_date) as opened_month, sum(days_since_opened_date) as total_days_since_opened_date, sort_array(collect_set(account_type)) as account_type_list
    from filtered_accounts
    group by date_trunc('MONTH', opened_date)
)
select opened_month, total_days_since_opened_date, account_type_list
from agg
where total_days_since_opened_date < 350
order by total_days_since_opened_date desc, opened_month
limit 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_accounts = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("account_type") == "CREDIT") & (F.col("opened_date") < "2025-06-16"))
    .withColumn("days_since_opened_date", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "opened_date"))
)

agg = (
    filtered_accounts
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("opened_month"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("days_since_opened_date").alias("total_days_since_opened_date"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("account_type_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("total_days_since_opened_date") < 350)
    .select("opened_month", "total_days_since_opened_date", "account_type_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("total_days_since_opened_date").desc(), "opened_month")
    .limit(1)
)

sql: select c.city, c.is_active, a.customer_id, a.account_type, a.balance, initcap(trim(a.account_type)) as account_type_title from customers c left join accounts a on c.id = a.customer_id where c.signup_date < '2023-09-01' and a.status = 'OPEN' order by account_type_title desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_customers.alias("c")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("a.customer_id"), "left")
    .filter((F.col("c.signup_date") < "2023-09-01") & (F.col("a.status") == "OPEN"))
    .select(

SELECT ss.product_id, COUNT(i.quantity) quantity_count, MAX(i.last_restock) last_last_restock
FROM inventory i
LEFT OUTER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IN (5, 6, 8)
GROUP BY ss.product_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ss"), (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("ss.store_id")) & (F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("ss.product_id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("i.product_id").isin([5, 6, 8]))
    .groupBy(F.col("ss.product_id"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("quantity_count"),
        F.max(F.col("i.last_restock")).alias("last_last_restock"),
    )
)
